name: InlineCitation
purpose: Numbered citations with preview cards and the list of sources behind an answer.
description: A small numbered chip right after a claim. Hover or focus shows a preview card (site, title, passage); the chip links to the source. The chip tints with `bg-ai-subtle` and `border-ai` on hover and focus.

index.notes: Figma: Number — the citation number, matching the source's position in Sources

source.notes: The cited source; its title, site and snippet fill the preview card

do: Place the chip right after the sentence or clause it supports, before the full stop of the next one.
Use one chip per source; repeat the number when a source supports several claims.
forbidden: Never put interactive content in the preview card.
Never cite with colour or superscript alone — always show the number.
